notes.title: Playing Herezh : Combat System
notes.notes:
Hello ! I'm Valentin “Elice”, developer for Herezh
Today I'm here to speak with you about a topic that most of you are waiting for the Combat system !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/3bb752c9f69826ea545b45579a3ff3e74186fabf.jpg[/img]

You, as a player, will be facing three types of encounters.
- Basic mobs, like goblins or zombies, not very harmful if you get ready
- World bosses, like giants or dragons (no, sorry I'm not gonna tease any new boss we have created). Each of them have their own behavior and multiple ways to take them down.
- Other players, we already said that they will be open PvP in the game.
Now that you know what you will be facing, let’s talk about your tools! We have three "combat styles" each with their own feeling and path to mastery.

First are melee weapons, inspired by souls games and influenced by some beat them all games like Devil May Cry or Bayonetta.
You, as a fighter, will have to observe how your opponent behaves and finely time your attacks, blocks and counters.
The attack is based on a 3 hit combo that you freely create using light and heavy attacks. From 3 light or 3 heavy strikes to light-heavy-light, it's up to you to mix you'r blows depending on the situation.
We also have three types of melee weapon, piercing, slashing and crushing, each type as its own combo.
Coming from the weapon itself you will have a different attack speed (and so reaction time) and damage.

Second comes the ranged weapon like slingshot and bow.
With this, we will test the accuracy of the player and his ability to aim something in motion.
First I will speak about the weapon, like previously for melee, each weapon has some difference like the range, reload speed, deviation and fall of the projectile.
So where is the damage stat? well it comes from the projectile combined with  some modifiers on the weapon stat.
Last but not least before moving to the last style, when using a ranged weapon, the localisation of your hit matters, and it’s not only about damage. For example, hitting the legs will reduce the target movement speed while the arm will affect the attack speed.

Lastly, Magic is more about strategy than the other two. As you will have to create your spells and choose between them (more about that in an upcoming news).
When a fight comes, you will have a small list of spells (that you’ve chosen from your known ones) and will have to stick to them. Sometimes you will be ready and have the best spell possible for the situation and sometimes you will be taken off guard and will have to improvise with what you have and the environment. If it’s raining, maybe you should forget about that fireball and think about something more “icy” or some flashy lightning, but try to aim  carefully, your clanmates don’t want to be hit.

That’s all for your weapons, but now let’s dive into the common fighting skills.
First you will be able to set up a few weapon presets that you will be able to switch between during the fight (allowing more possibility to adapt to every situation).
Each one will be able to dodge (if not doing something else at the same time) but you may ask “Am I able to cancel an attack to dodge” Yes and no, let me explain that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/d44ae68b350d2ed2692779f10cebb5b354602aed.png[/img]

The attaque preparation is the part of the animation before the character commits himself to the action. During this phase, you can cancel it.
The attack time is when we check if the attack hit something. At this point, you can no longer cancel the action.
The recovery is the end of the attack, and the moment you will be able to start the next action you want to do.
You are also able to perform a kick attack, only dealing a few damage but it’s a small knock back and also a good way to break enemy guard.

If you have any questions, feel free to come on discord and talk with us !
Elice out

notes.title: Playing Herezh : The topic of gender in Character Creation
notes.notes:
Hello ! Hi ! I’m Emma, concept artist for Herezh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/79fcf591fa6d39f31633af1b985a1766ac1cb360.png[/img]

Today we wanted to talk about character creation, gender, and what choices will be available to you as a player.
In Herezh, we want you to have as many options as possible while creating your character. Hair, markings, tattoos, and much more can be fine-tuned to offer you control over how you look.
Apart from the more obvious ones, there’s also something else that we feel is important to have the option over. In Herezh, you will also be able to mix and match your preferred :
• Masculine / Feminine Body appearance
• Masculine / Feminine Face appearance
• Masculine/ Feminine Posture (Think animations !)
As well as :
• Beards ! Does your character have one ? (Regardless of gender.)
• How you wish to be referred as, Hero ? (Pronouns)
Finally, there’s an option that will have an impact on your gameplay, and that is whether :
• Your character can make others pregnant / Your character can get pregnant

No matter who you are, we feel it’s important that you can tailor a character that suits you the best.
Thanks for reading and please continue to share the project where you can !
Emma

notes.title: Playing Herezh: crafting
notes.notes:
Hi guys ^^
Today we will talk crafting in Herezh which is a very important subject for me as I love crafting in RPGs and Survival games ;)
Crafting in Herezh comes in 8 flavours: Fabrication, Enchantment, Thaumaturgy, Alchemy, Cooking, Taming, Farming and Fishing each with it's own set of rules and gameplay.



[b]Fabrication:[/b] By using Fabrication a player can create items, from weapons and armors to buildings parts. The Fabrication skill of a character increases the durability, damage or armor of the item produced.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/a84b388617ab7f3a35d55ed99170fe04132f0090.jpg[/img]

[b]Enchantment:[/b] By using Enchantment a player can add a magical effect into a piece of equipment. The higher the Enchantment skill of the character the more powerful the effect will be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/48e19fb8db6d9fae2d7c3617d39213a7603bad79.jpg[/img]

[b]Thaumaturgy:[/b] By using Thaumaturgy a player can create a spell using Aether and Runes. Each spell is made up of 5 Runes types: Target, Duration, Range, Effect, Clan. By learning powerful Runes then using them to create his own spells a Sorcerez can be truly unique.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/e77f44b4582c34d30aee124789d81b38827ad7e0.jpg[/img]

[b]Alchemy:[/b] By using Alchemy a player can create potions, poisons and bombs by combining gathered ingredients. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/cf2ab71c9a6fdd08d573c4637119d271ef790964.jpg[/img]

[b]Cooking:[/b] By using Cooking the player can get long lasting buffs for himself and his clanmates by creating tasty food from ingredients.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/e43fdb660ade1fce7bfcec0288ddc928ba9600ae.jpg[/img]

[b]Taming: [/b]Most creatures can be tamed in Herezh, from animals to world bosses or even zombies!
[b]Farming:[/b] Farming allows the player to grow plants that are then used raw or with the Cooking and Alchemy skills, further increasing their efficiency.
[b]Fishing: [/b]Finally, fishing allows the player to, well, fish... 
I am very proud of the full set of crafting skills we will be offering our players, specially the Thaumaturgy skill, of course all of those skills have their own perk trees with at least two areas of specialization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/d3172c4aafa5afd6c757fc1df21b066e7a7bd0f5.jpg[/img]

That's all for today ^^
See you soon!
[b]François[/b]

notes.title: Playing Herezh: generational gameplay
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

It's François again ^^

This time I want to talk about our dash of [b]rogue-lite [/b]in Herezh: the generational gameplay.

In Herezh your character will have a set [b]lifespan [/b](like in The Sims for example) and once their time is up they will die and you will have to choose one of their [b]offspring [/b]to keep playing.

In addition your character can retire at any moment to leave the quest to a younger generation and become an NPC.

This will have a lot of benefits for your character:

[list]
[*]They will choose a[b] guardian ancestor[/b] that will boost their starting skills
[*]They will retain part of their level but will get a great [b]experience cost reduction[/b] to level-up
[*]They will gain [b]special abilities [/b]based of who their parents were
[/list]

With this system each generation will be stronger than the previous one leading to greater heroes and even more legendary deeds.

To get an offspring you will have to find a [b]partner[/b], they can be either a [b]PC or NPC [/b]and they can be [b]human or not quite[/b] and they can be of any gender.

Finally for those who don't want to let go of life their will be life extending potions and items and quests for [b]immortality[/b].

For the most hardcore servers, an [b]ironman [/b]mode will be available so that any death will have you choose a new character among your offspring!

All those features will be fully configurable on a server by server basis from the lifespan of a character to the old age penalties.

I really hope that you are as excited with this feature as I am ^^

See you soon

[b]François[/b]

notes.title: Playing Herezh: clans
notes.notes:
Hi guys :)

My name is François, I am the lead designer for Herezh and today i decided to talk to you about one of the features i am most excited about: the clans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/9c5da7d882f2899a55c44ca5b7424c0870d74a6c.jpg[/img] 

Clans in Herezh are groups of player and non-player characters that creates a settlement together a bit like guilds in mmorpg.
Players can have various ranks like Penn, Drouiz, Haroz or Marc'heg giving them different rights in the clan.
The Penn is the leader of the clan, making most of the decisions and giving out the ranks, he can also start polls to know what the rest of the clan think about very important decisions.
The Drouiz decides which god the clan is following and is the keeper of it's blessing (more about the pantheon and blessings in a future post) .
A Haroz can give orders to NPCs and take them to battle.
Finally a Marc'heg is a member with no special right.
NPCs don't have special rights but will be fighting, collecting resources and crafting simple items for the clan reducing the grind at higher level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/66a1e3aeec63d6bc275c2875a0644e2ee550a293.jpg[/img] 

Saving NPCs from monsters and convincing them to join your clan will be very important in Herezh as they will be useful in a number of ways, from protecting your settlement and collecting resources to finding the right partner to have offspring with.
Each clan will have a customized banner that will be reproduced on guards shields and armors and on some vanity items for buildings creating a sense of uniformity in the settlement.
Clans will also have a treasury composed of taxes taken from players and non-players characters that the Penn will be able to use to fund high difficulty crafting or purchases.
On a server basis, clans will be able to wage war on each others or become allied, they will also be able to commerce together linking their auction houses so that players from both clans can buy what's for sell in them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/6696ea88f24d7c901bb674428b116d38182a5c94.jpg[/img] 

Players will be able to enter in allied or neutral settlements and purchase goods directly from NPCs as in any rpg town. Of course, clansmen will probably get a discount!
As you can see we want the interactions between player and players/NPCs to be more interesting than just seek and destroy and be assured that you will need all the allies you can get to survive the land of Herezh and make your clan into a true empire.
Until next time!

[b]François[/b]

PS: I didn't have visuals to go with that update so i used some gameplay screenshots, i hope you'll like them ;)

notes.title: Exploring Herezh: the forest
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Starting today, we want to present you the beautiful biomes of Herezh. 
We aim for realistic graphics but fantasy feel for our environments, immersion and wonder first and foremost!
Here is a first visual below, to showcase what we want to achieve with the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/ed5aea04f7c40fb8631b7486e9665f12edf68a7b.png[/img]

The forest is one of the most welcoming biomes to explore in the game, a place where you can find rich fauna & flora. But be warned, there are still threats even in such a peaceful and enchanting place. 
Here for example the giants and goblin, that you saw fighting in the trailer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/741eb0ca3a7a5c8e0aec884d3234c6eba67f4e32.png[/img]

To make the forest as immersive as possible we want a good diversity of trees to populate our landscape. You will be able to walk across maples, oaks & pines. Some assets from our 3D artist Clément: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/d7e0b509268868d5353ee26def7a1f996d5779cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/6c0e4117b33d25e408f4d7e469f0c3864bdcdab0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/be526bcff5b5c763f772e0f6fc4855a5d9cbc002.jpg[/img]

Each biome in Herezh has a very special location unique on the map called a Wonder, a place of power and lore where artefacts and bosses can be found.
The wonder of the forest will be the Tree of Life where you'll be able to meet the Oracle and get guidance in your quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055044/0c8fba8c447ac2029a3f071acfc25c168bf4608a.jpg[/img]

I hope you enjoyed that first sneak peek, see you soon for more :)

[b]The Herezh team[/b]
